contacts.title: Chief Executive Officer

source.detail: DFSA Single Family Office listing (ref F003413), verified still active 2026-09-24. Confirmed active single-family office of the Tamer family (Tamer Group, a large Gulf pharmaceutical and consumer-goods distributor), governed by an Oversight Board of family members plus independent advisors. Its CEO spent ~20 years in private banking at Credit Agricole Indosuez and Lombard Odier — a buyer who already knows what a portfolio system is.
